summary: Strawberry Fields REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a Corporate Credit Facility (CCF) comprising a $100M term loan and a $200M revolving credit facility with Popular Bank, maturing June 18, 2029, with two one-year extensions. The loans bear interest at 1-month CME Term SOFR plus 275 bps, floor 5.50%. Proceeds will refinance existing secured bank debt and fund acquisitions, working capital, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event is involved.
